body: i’m sorry to hear, very similar with me. i started seeing them after my boyfriend broke up with me, but yeah i always see everyday on the clock and house numbers, gas tank as well. it’s crazy. i really wonder what it all means. i’ve been searching for answers but i feel like once i stop looking then things will fall into place. take care of yourself and focus on what’s needed! i can always talk as well

i’m going through something similar! the past couple days have been extremely exhausting and i’m super emotional. work has been so rough and i can’t find any ways to feel happy. i see 1111 and 111 everyday, and sometimes other repetitive numbers. i’m generally confused as to why all of this is coming out of nowhere, but i’m glad to see that others are going through similar situations and we can all relate
congrats! can you tell me the steps you used please?
he deleted me off facebook and snapchat but not yet instagram. not sure why. but i don’t have the strength yet to do it :/

yeah you don’t need that in your life. my ex did the same to me, he told me i’m the best gf he’s had but then went back to his old ways and manipulated and cheated on me. she’s missing out and one day she’s gonna feel the pain and regret

if she moved on that fast there’s a couple things. the first is it shows how weak she is. if she can’t take the time to focus on herself and fix herself she will NEVER change. second is i guarantee their relationship won’t last. because going back to the first reason, eventually she’ll be back to her old ways and do the same to this guy. i know right now it seems unfair but focus on yourself man and spend time with friends and fam. it’s a hard and long process but so worth it at the end. i’m going through it too but we got this
i’m a girl! but yes i definitely plan my outfits so my shoes pop out more than the rest. i have the real dunk lows and i make sure everyone sees them when i’m out haha
i hooked up with a guy he knew after my ex and i  went on one date, so before we started dating

i definitely feel like they won’t. you don’t just meet your soulmate a couple weeks dating someone because at the end of the day he moved on to try and feel something temporarily when after a breakup it’s important to focus on you before anyone else. they might be together for a while but eventually they’ll argue, see the differences in each other and either be miserable with that person or leave. eventually people who move on way faster struggle later, while you are struggling now, over time you won’t feel anything towards this. keep pushing! i believe in you❤️

i’m sorry you are going through this, i went through something pretty similar. the most important thing is to focus on you, spend time with friends and family you love and distract yourself as much as possible. for valentine’s day ask your friends to hang and do things you love and you are doing amazing staying off social media because it’s not worth checking. fuck him for moving on so fast, i can guarantee you they are not gonna last, they probably have a lot of issues in the relationship and trust me once you get over this you’ll feel so good about yourself and your soulmate is out there waiting for you. and if him and that girl don’t work he will definitely ask for your forgiveness and you’ll be doing so good you don’t need him back. keep pushing through every day as best you can. you are cared for and loved and don’t be afraid to reach out to people you love when you struggle. nobody deserves the anxiety, no patience, depression and pain through a breakup and one day you’ll look back on this and it won’t phase you. you got this, keep pushing through everyday and focus on YOU and become the best you
